cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Not That Subject
cards.instruction: Choose one subject you cannot let the scene reach. Redirect whenever the conversation gets close.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. I've booked your car into that garage with the café. Shall we have breakfast there?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why does my car need a garage?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. Their full breakfast includes unlimited toast. You always say that's important.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll look at the car while you order.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's take the bus. Then we can both have the breakfast cocktails.

mechanism: A borrows a confident menu ritual to avoid discussion of the damaged car that brought them to the garage.
confusable: D06 probes information; D14 consistently redirects away from one chosen subject. S04 must mistake the borrowed ritual.
comparison: Mechanical bad news avoided through dining versus financial notice avoided through household display.
seedUse: D14-a shifts car inspection into a breakfast activity.
